searchText: Teku should be good to for devnet-1. Fixed the last two known issues today 🙂 Passing all v1.5.0-alpha.3 tests! Any EL devs wanna chime in? <@905058765022310460> <@583892532644151312> <@877270907314372629> <@806184091690598420> I think we're okay on CL readiness, launching with 3/5 on both side would be nice Do we have a devnet-1 overview page? 🙂 https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/pectra-devnet-1 Thanks 😄 At Besu we are still fixing bugs discovered with the latest version of the execution tests. With the 4th of July weekend and part of the team being off until next week, we will need until mid to end of next week to be ready for devnet-1. what branch is this image based on? the image is unfortunately for arm only :/ lightclient/go-ethereum:prague-devnet-1 reth is not entirely ready, wrapping up 7702 and almost done with consolidation eip, but should be ready eow
